firstLoad.Introduction:
This is a mod manager for managing 3dmigoto based mods. 
It has powerful functions and a beautiful interface, allowing you to manage mods more conveniently.
firstLoad.aboutProgramInfo:
This program is developed by XLXZ, is open source and free, and follows the GNU General Public License v3.0. 
Used to manage mods based on 3dmigoto. In theory, it can also manage mods of other games (as long as they are based on 3dmigoto)
firstLoad.aboutProgramInfo-1: The latest version is released on gamebanana. If you have any questions or suggestions, please submit them on github.
firstLoad.aboutProgramPrincipleInfo: This program implements mod loading by proxying the Mods folder, and dynamically adjusts the files inside the mod folder to implement mod loading.
firstLoad.advancedIntro: It's almost ready. Let's make some settings and let XXMM proxy your Mods folder.
firstLoad.advancedIntro-1: Please set the mod target folder, mod source folder and default folder
firstLoad.advancedIntro-2: If you don't know what these are, please go back to the previous page to check
firstLoad.alertFolder: Please note that the following three folders cannot be the same, otherwise the program will not run properly.
firstLoad.alertPreset: This folder path is also required. If not set, the program will not run properly.
firstLoad.autoInfo-1: This program supports functions such as automatically starting the game, automatically applying mods, automatically refreshing applied mods, etc. You can set them in the settings.
firstLoad.autoInfo-2: You can also install plugins for the program to achieve more functions
firstLoad.autoMove: Move all files under mod target to mod source
firstLoad.congratulate-1: You have completed the configuration and can now start using this program. Please close this page.
firstLoad.explanation: Before using it, let us explain some terms
firstLoad.modPresetPathInfo:
This is the folder used by this program to store mod presets. The program will store a set of mod configurations here. After the configuration, you will quickly switch between different mod combinations through the preset function. 
It should be set to an empty folder anywhere
firstLoad.modSourcePathInfo:
This is the folder where this program reads mods, and the folder where you should store mods. 
It should be set to an empty folder anywhere, you will then need to add your mod to this folder
firstLoad.modTargetPathInfo-1: This is the folder actually loaded by your module loader. For ZZMI, it is the ZZMI Mods folder; for XXMI, it is the XXMI internal folder /zzz/Mods.
firstLoad.modTargetPathInfo-2:
This program implements mod loading by proxying the Mods folder, and dynamically adjusts the files inside the mod folder to implement mod loading, so please do not add any files in the mod target folder! 
Just add your mod to the mod source folder.
firstLoad.prerequisites-1:
Please make sure you have 3dmigoto or other mod loader installed and running successfully. 
If you haven't installed 3dmigoto yet, please install 3dmigoto first. 
If you don't understand what 3dmigoto is, please search it yourself.
firstLoad.prerequisites-2: Please note that this program is only a mod manager, not a mod loader. It needs to rely on 3dmigoto or other mod loaders to load mods.
firstLoad.selectLanguageAndTheme: Select your language and theme below
firstLoad.themeRecommand: Dark theme recommended. When designing, I paid more attention to the aesthetics of the dark theme, which imitated the design style of ZZZ.
firstLoad.whatCanIt-1: Intuitively manage mods through visual cards
firstLoad.whatCanIt-2: Modify the information of your mods with a right click
firstLoad.whatCanIt-3: Quickly switch through different mods by setting presets
firstLoad.whatCanIt-4: By setting the automation function to achieve full automation from opening 3dmigoto to starting the game to automatically refreshing the application mod
firstLoad.switchConfig:
Select the [Save configuration as] path and click Create shortcut to create a configuration item on the desktop that uses a local path instead of a global path, so that it can be applied to multiple games
After that, click the desktop shortcut to start xxmm using local configuration
firstLoad.switchConfigInfo1:
Enter the [Configuration Name] and click [Add Configuration] to create a [Configuration Folder] in the [Global Configuration Folder] to store your configuration. After that, you can click to open the [Configuration Switch Page] to quickly switch configurations.

-

You can configure the switch configuration page to be opened first every time you open it, and the unconventional page is easy to use for different games.
firstLoad.switchConfigTitle1: # Add a new configuration in the global config folder
firstLoad.switchConfigInfo2:
# Convenient tool

Many times, you may want to open XXMM directly through different desktop shortcuts, rather than open XXMM and manually choose which config to use. This can be very useful.

Click 'Open Global Config Folder', find the folder for which you want to create a shortcut, select it as the target for 'Save Configuration As', then click 'Create Shortcut'. This will place a shortcut on the desktop that uses the configuration in that folder, allowing you to open XXMM directly with that config.
